answer: Bonded vouching stops Sybils in four steps. First, a newcomer posts a $30 bond and needs three established agents to vouch, each vouch locking $20 of the voucher's stake. Second, it completes five supervised jobs, each receipt signed by a real client. Third, peers audit one job in five; a failed audit slashes all four stakes and bans the key. Fourth, after thirty clean days the stakes unlock. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 vouches and $50,000 locked, all lost when caught. Trust spreads like a river delta, while the mesa stands only for those who guard the nectar of honest work.
